referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A Colorado mountain image under deep navy frames a large white repair promise, red call/request actions and a compact row of reasons to trust the process. Thin utility bar and straightforward heating, cooling and service links above the dramatic photo opening. Heavy readable sans statements, compact explanatory cards and clear red action labels. The page sequence runs from mountain repair hero to service taxonomy to diagnosis promise band toward FAQ, resource index, final contact. Mountain and Denver location scenes are sparse; most of the long page is text, process diagrams and service-choice cards. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
